rules.title: Santa Ana AI Rent Pricing Software Ban
rules.requirement: Santa Ana prohibits landlords and apartment owners from using algorithmic devices/AI software to set rental prices, with fines for violations.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to landlords and apartment owners/managers in Santa Ana using algorithmic pricing devices to set rents.
rules.quoted_span: The purpose and intent of this [ordinance] is to protect the residents of Santa Ana from artificially inflated rental rates and unfair rent increases by prohibiting the sale, licensing and use of Algorithmic Devices,
rules.conflict_note: Exact effective date and specific code section not stated in article; only that the final vote occurred and the ordinance was 'put into effect.'
